# Quote: Juniper Lane Dental

**Prepared by:** Bluewick IT | **Valid for:** 30 days from date of issue

## 1. Summary

Juniper Lane needs new PCs, business-grade Wi-Fi, backups that support its HIPAA obligations, and monthly IT support. The full scope is **$21,446.00** one-off, which is over the **$15,000** budget. We recommend **Phase 1 at $14,927.25**, which fits the budget and fixes the most urgent risks first.

Two findings from our site survey affect scope:
- There are **12 PCs in use, not 10**. The extra two are operatory imaging PCs running SensorView v6, which the imaging vendor certifies only on specific hardware. Replacing them needs the vendor's sign-off, so they sit in Phase 2.
- The **last successful backup was 4 months ago**, and the practice-management database holds patient records. Backup is the top priority.

## 2. Scope (Phase 1, recommended)

- Replace **7 staff workstations**. Existing monitors are reused. Data is migrated and PCs deployed.
- Install a business firewall with security subscription, a 24-port managed PoE switch, and **3 access points** for full coverage.
- Install a backup appliance plus encrypted cloud backup (the cloud vendor signs a BAA), then run and document a test restore.
- Provide monthly managed support for 11 users.
- Bluewick will sign a Business Associate Agreement. The backup design supports Juniper Lane's HIPAA obligations. It does not by itself make the practice compliant.

## 3. One-off costs (Phase 1)

| Item | Qty | Unit price | Amount |
|---|---|---|---|
| Business PC (i5, 16 GB, 512 GB SSD) | 7 | $960.00 | $6,720.00 |
| Wi-Fi access point | 3 | $347.00 | $1,041.00 |
| Firewall appliance | 1 | $640.00 | $640.00 |
| 24-port managed PoE switch | 1 | $720.00 | $720.00 |
| Backup appliance | 1 | $1,200.00 | $1,200.00 |
| **Hardware subtotal** | | | **$10,321.00** |
| PC deployment and data migration (2.5 h each) | 17.5 h | $125.00 | $2,187.50 |
| Network install | 10 h | $125.00 | $1,250.00 |
| Backup setup and test restore | 6 h | $125.00 | $750.00 |
| Project management (10% of labour) | 1 | $418.75 | $418.75 |
| **Labour subtotal** | | | **$4,606.25** |
| **Total one-off (Phase 1)** | | | **$14,927.25** |

## 4. Recurring costs

| Item | Qty | Unit price | Monthly | Annual |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Managed support (per user) | 11 | $95/mo | $1,045.00 | $12,540.00 |
| Encrypted cloud backup (BAA-backed) | 1 | $150/mo | $150.00 | $1,800.00 |
| Firewall security subscription | 1 | $420/yr | n/a | $420.00 |
| **Total** | | | **$1,195.00/mo** | **$14,760.00/yr** |

The firewall subscription is billed annually. Recurring charges begin at Phase 1 go-live and are **not** part of the $15,000 project budget.

## 5. Options

| Option | Includes | One-off |
|---|---|---|
| A. Everything now | 12 PCs, network, backup | $21,446.00 |
| **B. Phased (recommended)** | **Phase 1 now (above): 7 PCs, network, backup. Phase 2 later: 3 staff PCs and 2 imaging PCs ($6,518.75, indicative).** | **$14,927.25 now** |
| C. Infrastructure only | Network, firewall, backup, no PCs | $5,801.00 |

Phase 2 is 5 PCs at $960 each ($4,800) plus 12.5 h deployment ($1,562.50) and 10% project management ($156.25). The imaging PC price is indicative, because vendor-certified hardware may cost more. We will re-quote Phase 2 once the vendor signs off.

**Recommendation: Option B.**
- Backup is the most urgent risk. Four months without a backup of patient records is serious exposure.
- The firewall and managed network close a major security gap.
- Seven PCs fit the budget. We suggest replacing the oldest or slowest first.
- Imaging PCs cannot be replaced safely until the vendor approves the hardware. Phasing avoids rushing that step.
- Total cost is the same as Option A, just spread out. Option C would leave the aging PCs untouched, so it is a fallback only.

## 6. Assumptions and exclusions

- Existing monitors are reused and in working order.
- Cabling is in place and usable. New cable runs, if needed, are quoted separately.
- Cloud backup capacity is sized to the current data volume, confirmed at kickoff.
- Excluded: imaging PCs and vendor fees (Phase 2), SensorView licensing or vendor labour, software licences beyond the OS, sales tax, a formal HIPAA risk assessment, and any interim backup before project start (available at $125/h).
- Staff data is assumed to be on the PCs or accessible server for migration.

## 7. Terms

- Valid for 30 days from date of issue.
- A **50% hardware deposit ($5,160.50)** is due on acceptance. The balance of **$9,766.75** is due on completion.
- Phase 2 follows the same terms.
- Bluewick will sign a BAA before accessing patient data.

---

## Cover email

**Subject:** Quote for Juniper Lane Dental

Hi Mary,

Thanks for your note. Our quote is attached.

Two things came up at the site visit. You have 12 PCs in use, because the two imaging PCs also need replacing. The imaging vendor must approve replacement hardware, so we've put those in a second phase. Your last successful backup was also four months ago, so I'd treat backup as urgent. Until the new system is live, please plug in the USB drive and run a backup today.

The full project is $21,446. To stay within your $15,000 budget, we recommend Phase 1 at **$14,927.25**: new Wi-Fi, firewall, switch, backups that support your HIPAA obligations (we'll sign a BAA), and 7 new PCs. The remaining PCs follow in Phase 2. Monthly support is $1,195, including cloud backup.

Happy to talk it through.

Best regards,
[Name], Bluewick IT

---

## Internal note (owner)

- List prices on all hardware are below our 25% margin floor (PC 19.9%, AP 23.3%, firewall 23.7%, switch 22.7%, backup appliance 24.4%). I repriced to 25% or better.
- Client said 10 PCs, but there are 12. The two imaging PCs need SensorView vendor sign-off.
- Full scope is $21,446 against a $15,000 budget. I recommend phasing.
- The last backup was 4 months ago. Decide whether we offer an interim backup free of charge.
- I avoided "HIPAA compliant" wording.
